campaign: CP02 B — memoria diferencial y predicción prospectiva de transporte persistente
freeze: before confirmatory, controls and reserved runs
family: relational.v1 H0; physical zero-load past-outcome sensors
published_scope: phase-qualified persistence forecast from a previous observed outcome; not arbitrary precursor association learning
environment: external deterministic barrier, one packet attempts passage at every integer tick independently of forecasting; stable open or closed; reference branch inverts the condition; optional fixed context change at tick80
environment_prediction_independence: habitat has no Runtime, prediction, decoder or forecasting input
sensor_codec: actual past arrival A; actual past non-arrival B; zero-load physical event in declared neighbor channel; primary then inverse reference
decoder: live native comparator direction x >0 arrival; x<0 absence; x=0, missing or rejected probe -> unresolved set {absence,arrival}
before_emission_allowed_information: past sensor symbols, timestamps, admission receipts
baseline: first actually available past primary outcome, persistence; same sensors and timing; abstain if missing

criteria.metric: binary error on singleton predictions; coverage and set containment reported separately
criteria.phase_domain: first event at absolute32, initial local clock260
criteria.generalization_unit: different preparation/history, not each target tick as independent replicate
